name: Data.exists_family_covolumeSq_le
summary: A basis of the span of the short translates of Theorems A and B, with Hadamard's inequality.

steps.claim: From Theorem A: q > 0, B = q·P_D, S ⊆ integralRamified(D) spanning the ramified columns (hS, sp) with the size bound (size), and the index statement (index). From Theorem B: t with #t·dim Column(D) ≤ 5·dim rows(D)·log(1 + b_D²) (ht) and (1 − 4/b_D²)·dim rows(D) ≤ dim ∑_{s∈t} range P_{D,s} (big).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨q, q0, B, hB, ⟨S, hS, sp, size⟩, index⟩, -, -, t, ht, big⟩ :=
    D.short_forms, D.enough_forms

steps.claim: Put Y := {B_s(φ) : s ∈ t, φ ∈ S}.
Choose a linearly independent family y : Fin n → rows(D) of members of Y (hy) with n = dim span Y (Mathlib's `exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq`).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨y, hy, -, i⟩ := exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq ℂ Y

steps.claim: ∑_{s∈t} range P_{D,s} = span Y, since S spans the ramified columns and q ≠ 0; so big reads (1 − 4/b_D²)·dim rows(D) ≤ n.
steps.lean:
rw [(by simp [Y, ← Set.iUnion_image_left, span_iUnion₂, sp]
          simp [hB, range_smul, q0.ne'] : iSup _ = span ℂ Y)] at big

steps.claim: The family y works: it is independent with n ≥ (1 − 4/b²)·dim rows (step 4); δ := #t·dim Column(D)·𝓑(D) ≤ 5·dim rows(D)·log(1 + b_D²)·𝓑(D) (ht, 𝓑 ≥ 0), and IndexLe(D, y, δ) by Theorem A (b) since S ⊆ integralRamified(D); and by Hadamard's inequality (`covolumeSq_le`) the squared covolume of Θ_D(1)∘y at σ is ≤ exp(n·(h_main − m·rem + log b·𝓑)), every y_i = B_s(φ) with φ ∈ S having squared norm ≤ exp(h_main − m·rem + log b·𝓑) (size).
steps.lean:
exact ⟨_, y, i, big, ⟨_, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (HasLogBound.pos D).le, index t _ y
    (Set.image2_subset_left hS <| hy ·)⟩, fun σ ↦ covolumeSq_le
    (have ⟨s, _, φ, h, e⟩ := hy ·; by simpa [e] using size φ h s σ)⟩
